# PRFlow Review (shadow) — PR #1935

**Verdict: APPROVE**

## Diff profile
Test-only change: single file `lib/test/run.sh`. Three credential-refresher liveness test arms (#487 arm13, #491 arm20b, #1882 arm1882k) gain (a) a shared block env-isolation preamble (`unset DEVFLOW_REFRESH_SELFTEST_FAILED`; `export DEVFLOW_REFRESH_REAP_GLOB` to a non-matching glob), (b) bounded retry loops (<=40 tries, 0.2s backoff) breaking on fixture-live + non-empty capture (arm1882k: non-empty only), and (c) removal of dead pre-init lines. No engine/prompt-surface/CLAUDE.md paths touched.

## Acceptance criteria (issue #1931)
- AC1 (target arms, slack-only fix) — SATISFIED. Each arm wrapped in a bounded retry adjusting only its own capture slack; retained `assert_eq` lines and expected values unchanged; CLAUDE.md untouched.
- AC2 (no-known-flake rule + remedy present/unweakened) — SATISFIED. CLAUDE.md is outside the diff; the change is itself an application of its slack-budget remedy.
- AC3 (non-vacuity: each arm still RED against a mutated stop-refresher) — SATISFIED. Break conditions gate on fixture liveness and non-empty capture, independent of assertion expected values; stop-refresher emits deterministically non-empty output on each arm, so a real regression breaks on iteration 1 and the unchanged assertion runs on the bad capture -> RED. Starvation that never resolves exhausts the loop and surfaces as a RED positive assertion, not a skipped/green check.
- AC4 (full suite passes + shellcheck clean) — NOT EXECUTED in this read-only shadow pass; the added constructs (C-style `for (( ))`, `${var//[[:space:]]/}`, quoted `kill`/`wait`) are bash-clean with no obvious SC warning. Final confirmation rests with CI / the orchestrator's in-env run.

## Findings
No Critical or Important findings.

- Suggestion: `export DEVFLOW_REFRESH_REAP_GLOB` at line ~48645 leaks process-globally with no restore. Verified currently inert (every downstream arm overrides it inline; the glob matches nothing). Latent coupling for any future arm relying on the default reap glob. Corroborated across requesting-code-review (Suggestion), pr-test-analyzer and silent-failure-hunter (informational). Non-blocking.
- Suggestion/informational: arm13's first assertion would false-green on an empty capture in isolation, but is fully guarded by the sibling liveness assertion; non-vacuity holds. Note only.

## Reviewers
Dispatched roster (5): code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, requesting-code-review. type-design-analyzer gated out (no new types). All five returned non-empty assessments.

## Verdict rationale
All agents concur the change is a correct, minimal slack-widening wrapper that preserves every assertion's ability to catch a real stop-refresher regression, with no process leaks and no CLAUDE.md weakening. The only surviving finding is a below-threshold Suggestion. Verdict: APPROVE.
